app.name: GridPulse
app.tagline: Grid situational awareness from official public data

common.staleHint: Data is older than expected – use with care.

situation.title: Situation
situation.flowsHint: Positive = import into Germany, negative = export

outlook.title: Outlook
outlook.noWindows: No negative prices or dunkelflaute risk within the forecast horizon.
outlook.basis: Based on the official forecasts of the data sources.
outlook.basisModel: Also shown: own model, because it beats the official forecast in the backtest.
outlook.backtestNone: No backtest yet: the model needs at least 14 days of history with weather data (Open-Meteo), actuals and the official forecast (SMARD). The worker retrains daily.
outlook.active: Shown – more accurate than the official forecast (MAE and MAPE)
outlook.inactive: Not shown – the official forecast is more accurate
outlook.backtestWindow: Test window {start} to {end} ({points} hours), training from {train}.
outlook.caveat: Note: for past hours Open-Meteo stores values close to observations, not the forecast available at the time – the backtest therefore flatters the own model. MAPE only over hours with |residual load| ≥ 1 GW.

countries.title: Country comparison
countries.intro: Load and day-ahead price per bidding zone (Germany and its neighbours) from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, hourly means.
countries.priceChart: Day-ahead prices per bidding zone (−24 h to +24 h)
countries.emptyToken: The country comparison needs data from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Set a personal security token in the environment variable GRIDPULSE_ENTSOE_TOKEN (free after registration; request it by e-mail to transparency@entsoe.eu).
countries.emptyHint: Without a token GridPulse keeps running on SMARD, Energy-Charts and Open-Meteo. Once the token is set, the worker loads the data on its next run (every 15 min).

events.title: Events
events.none: No events in the selected period.

history.title: History
history.hint: Times in Europe/Berlin; daily values follow calendar days (23/25 h on DST changes).

footer.disclaimer: GridPulse is a read-only, advisory tool. It sends no control commands, is not connected to control systems and is no substitute for certified control systems.
